# unifi_network_wlan (Resource)

A UniFi Wi-Fi network/SSID (`wlanconf`). Models the configurable surface: security (WPA2/WPA3, PMF), the network/VLAN it bridges onto, AP groups, bands, MAC filtering, minimum data rates, fast roaming, and guest policies.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The SSID.

### Optional

- `ap_group_ids` (Set of String) IDs of the AP groups (`unifi_network_ap_group`) this SSID broadcasts on.
- `ap_group_mode` (String) How `ap_group_ids` is applied: `all` or `exclude`.
- `bands` (Set of String) Radio bands to broadcast on: `2g`, `5g`, `6g`.
- `bss_transition` (Boolean) 802.11v BSS transition management.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the SSID is broadcast.
- `fast_roaming_enabled` (Boolean) 802.11r fast roaming.
- `group_rekey` (Number) GTK group-rekey interval in seconds.
- `hide_ssid` (Boolean) Don't broadcast the SSID name.
- `hotspot2_enabled` (Boolean) Hotspot 2.0 / Passpoint.
- `is_guest` (Boolean) Apply guest policies (isolation, captive portal).
- `l2_isolation` (Boolean) Block client-to-client (layer 2) traffic.
- `mac_filter_enabled` (Boolean) Enable the MAC address allow/deny list.
- `mac_filter_list` (Set of String) MAC addresses for the filter list.
- `mac_filter_policy` (String) MAC filter policy: `allow` (whitelist) or `deny` (blacklist).
- `mcast_enhance_enabled` (Boolean) Multicast enhancement (convert multicast to unicast).
- `minrate_na_data_rate_kbps` (Number) 5 GHz minimum data rate (kbps).
- `minrate_na_enabled` (Boolean) Enforce a minimum data rate on 5 GHz.
- `minrate_ng_data_rate_kbps` (Number) 2.4 GHz minimum data rate (kbps).
- `minrate_ng_enabled` (Boolean) Enforce a minimum data rate on 2.4 GHz.
- `mlo_enabled` (Boolean) Wi-Fi 7 multi-link operation.
- `network_id` (String) ID of the network/VLAN (`unifi_network_network`) this SSID bridges onto.
- `no_2ghz_oui` (Boolean) Steer known 5 GHz-capable clients off 2.4 GHz.
- `passphrase` (String, Sensitive) WPA pre-shared key (for `security = wpapsk`). The controller echoes it on read, so it is also Computed: unset for `open`/`wpaeap` SSIDs it reads back as the controller's value (empty).
- `pmf_mode` (String) Protected Management Frames: `disabled`, `optional`, or `required`.
- `proxy_arp` (Boolean) Answer ARP on behalf of clients.
- `radius_mac_auth_enabled` (Boolean) MAC-based RADIUS authentication.
- `radius_profile_id` (String) ID of the RADIUS profile (`unifi_network_radius_profile`) this SSID binds to — required for `security = wpaeap` (802.1X enterprise) and used by MAC-based RADIUS auth.
- `security` (String) Security suite: `open`, `wpapsk` (personal), or `wpaeap` (enterprise/RADIUS).
- `uapsd_enabled` (Boolean) WMM power save (U-APSD).
- `user_group_id` (String) ID of the user group (bandwidth profile) applied to clients.
- `wpa3_enhanced_192` (Boolean) WPA3 Enterprise 192-bit mode.
- `wpa3_support` (Boolean) Offer WPA3 alongside WPA2.
- `wpa3_transition` (Boolean) WPA2/WPA3 transition mode.
- `wpa_mode` (String) WPA cipher/mode (e.g. `wpa2`, `wpa3`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
- `setting_preference` (String) Controller auto/manual toggle (read-only).
